title: Chapter 644
text:
The Black Star Corps' fleet blended in with the Alliance Army's fleet and advanced forward majestically. Countless hyperdrive streams of light streaked across the dark universe like a meteor shower.

"… The frontal forces will attack and break through the defense formation in outer space. Attack the enemy's ground base and cover the troops to attract their firepower. We will be in charge of controlling the flanks and preventing the enemy from changing formations and providing reinforcements."

In the cockpit, Han Xiao instructed the various captains in the communication channel.

The post structure of the Black Star Corps had already stabilized. The three hundred battleships were divided into multiple fleets, and the various officers were in charge of them.

"Lagi, the mission of charging and breaking through the enemy lines will be handed to you. The other allies will also be controlling the flanks. They have also sent out their own Calamity Grade Supers. Your job is to damage the enemy's fleet as much as possible … Of course, the prerequisite is that you have to protect yourself."

Han Xiao's tone was solemn. In a galactic war, Calamity Grades were mainly used for assassination. However, they could also participate in a frontal battle. Powerful individual strength meant high flexibility. If there were no Grade A opponents to control them, a powerful Calamity Grade would be able to cause significant damage to the fleet and even have the chance to influence the direction of the battle.

For example, Shana's ability was a killing machine in a galactic war.

In the galactic battlefield, Grade A Supers were always a headache for the commanders because the uncertainty was too high. A Calamity Grade with the protection of a fleet was even more dangerous.

However, facing a fleet head-on was still very dangerous for a Calamity Grade. If they were not careful, they would be hit by the concentrated firepower of hundreds of battleships. However, Han Xiao was not worried about Lagi. With how cowardly he was, there would definitely be no problem for him to protect himself.

"Sigh …"

Lagi sighed and did not wish to speak.

Dong dong!

The cabin shook slightly, and the fleet exited hyperdrive mode. Han Xiao frowned and turned on the radar. A red area appeared in front of him.

"We're here. The vanguard of the Bloodshed Land is right in front of us."

Han Xiao took a deep breath.

After three years, they were still going to face the Bloodshed Land.

In the communication channel, many people held their breaths for a moment.

It was no wonder that the members of Section Zero were nervous. The Bloodshed Land was extremely famous, and no one dared to underestimate the Tyrant.

Through the long-range vision, Han Xiao discovered that the Bloodshed Land's fleet had gathered in outer space, forming a formation with the flagship as the core.

"Warning! Warning! A high energy reaction has been detected. Please take cover in advance, hum!"

At this time, Han Xiao received Philip's warning. He called out and led his fleet to hide.

The next moment, the Bloodshed Land's fleet suddenly lit up with countless light spots. Then, countless high-energy particle cannons instantly approached the alliance army, brushing past the shields of spaceships and disappearing into the distance. A few spaceships that did not manage to dodge in time were hit, and their shields flickered.

"How decisive, opening fire as soon as they meet." Han Xiao's eyes narrowed.

Ding.

At this time, Philip raised his voice.

"Tactical orders have been received. Do you wish to execute them immediately?"

On the virtual screen, the formations of the two fleets had been visualized. The situation was clear at a glance. The tactical movements of their own fleets were marked out. There were feints, sudden assaults, traps, and so on. The division of labor was clear. Han Xiao's unit was also given a tactical target by the long-range commander. The enemy fleet that needed to be restrained had been marked in red. This was the mission target. On the top left of the screen, various tactical parameters and timings were listed.

The commander at the rear would adjust his tactics according to the situation and issue new orders. This method of command allowed each team to perform their own duties and not cause chaos.

Han Xiao looked at the tactical target, and seeing that there was no problem, he nodded.

"Execute it immediately!"

The Black Star Corps fleet immediately followed the troops and circled around, charging toward the mission target from the side.

At the same time, the entire Section Zero alliance army also moved. They spread out and attacked the Bloodshed Land's stronghold from all directions.

Because the alliance army was basically a sheet of loose sand, in order to prevent the members from fighting alone, the commander had split the alliance army into more than ten teams. Han Xiao's fleet was a member of 'Team Seven', and their main mission was to restrain the flanks.

The war broke out!

The Section Zero alliance army approached the fortress planet from all directions. Both sides fired their cannons at each other, and spaceships shuttled through the densely packed particle cannons, exploding into fireworks from time to time. As the alliance army attacked from multiple fronts, the Bloodshed Land also changed their formation to protect every direction.

Both sides went all out as soon as they exchanged blows. Team Seven charged through the cannon fire, and the pressure on them increased with every distance they advanced.

Bang! Bang! Bang!

The Bloodshed Land's vanguard had already used the Red Empire's Base Expansion Package to modify the fortress planet. There was already a large base on the surface, and the anti-air cannons shot out missiles one after another into outer space. The firepower was ferocious, and it almost hit Han Xiao's fleet.

"A large-scale battlefield is really dangerous."

Han Xiao had already switched to manual piloting, and he was highly focused. With a thrilling maneuver, he barely dodged the dozen or so cannons that were fired at him.

In such a huge battlefield, he did not dare be too reckless and followed the movements of the main force, flying up and down like a butterfly, nimbly dodging the attacks.

Looking at the tactical screen, Han Xiao saw that the frontal assault force had already engaged in close combat with the Bloodshed Land. He looked out the window and saw that the entire outer space had already turned into an intense battlefield. The background was the pitch-black universe and the edge of the fortress planet. Battleships were fighting each other, and the light of various weapons was extremely dazzling.

The battlefield was too vast, and even if one looked into the distance, they would not be able to see the overall situation. They could only understand the overall situation of the war from the tactical screen.

The attacks of the alliance army had diverted the enemy's firepower, which indirectly helped Han Xiao's Team Seven to get closer to the enemy, find their target, and quickly engage them.

Han Xiao's location instantly became a new battlefield.

…

As soon as the battle started, Han Xiao felt immense pressure.

This fleet had an Extreme-level flagship as the core, and it seemed like they were going to support the frontline. Team Seven tried to harass them but was immediately met with a fierce counterattack.

Team Seven had thousands of battleships, and among them were three hundred of Han Xiao's battleships. The number of casualties rose rapidly.

"Not easy to deal with!"

Han Xiao clenched his teeth.

Even if Purple Crystal would compensate him, he could not help but feel heartache for the battleships that had exploded one after another. These were the stocks that he had accumulated with great difficulty.

Han Xiao used Virtual Intrusion and immediately met with resistance. The Bloodshed Land fleet also had a Virtual Mechanic to protect the control of the fleet and invade the spaceships of the alliance army.

With no other choice, Han Xiao engaged the enemy's Virtual Mechanic, attacking and defending at the same time. Both sides engaged in a tug of war.

At the same time, in the command room of the fortress planet, two Grade A Virtual Mechanics were intercepted by Han Xiao in the virtual world, and their expressions changed.

"The enemy's Virtual Mechanic has also made his move!"

"This fellow's Virtual Technology is very strong. His invasion speed is too fast!"

"Thankfully, we can barely defend the internal firewall. Did you manage to trace him?"

"Hmm, I've locked onto his location."

"… I see him. Hmm? So, he's Black Star. No wonder he's so strong!"

"Cooperate with my counterattack and snatch his spaceship!"

The two of them had a tacit understanding and locked onto Han Xiao, quickly invading the BlackLight Stealth.

In the virtual world, the torrent of data controlled by the two of them found the intelligence core of the BlackLight Stealth. Just as they were about to attack, a glowing figure suddenly appeared. It was Risda.

Two torrents of data collided, and Risda stretched out his hand to pull them apart. The attacks of the two of them were instantly disrupted, and the torrent of data turned into light fragments, becoming meaningless data that was quickly shattered.

Seeing this, the two of them were shocked.

"This intelligence core's level is so high. There's no way to break through it."

"Sh * t, we can't get rid of him."

The two of them had completed a round of exchanges. Han Xiao had a slight advantage, but his expression became grave.

He had long expected that Bloodshed Land would send out Virtual Mechanics, and they would not leave such an obvious weakness behind. However, the enemy had sent out two Grade A Virtual Mechanics, which made Han Xiao feel pressured. If he was not here, the enemy would be able to do whatever they wanted.

At this moment, the two of them were restraining each other. Although he could not use Virtual Intrusion to open up the battlefield, neither could the enemy.

At this moment, the two of them finally engaged in close combat, and a boarding battle broke out. Team Seven and the enemy fleet used charge cabins to allow their Supers to board the enemy's spaceship.

Han Xiao pulled out the surveillance video. The spaceship that was boarded was almost a one-sided massacre. The elite troops of Bloodshed Land, the Thousand Beast Soldiers, were extremely powerful.

"My spaceship has been boarded!"

At this moment, Herlous' anxious voice sounded in the communication channel.

Han Xiao hurriedly looked over and saw three charge cabins biting onto Herlous' spaceship. Herlous was leading the troops on the spaceship to block the Thousand Beast Soldiers that had boarded. They were in a stalemate.

At this moment, Lagi's spaceship passed by and quickly provided support, easily killing a group of enemies and resolving Herlous' dangerous situation.

Han Xiao was energized and found a breakthrough point in the chaotic battle.

"Attention, all of you, cover the Calamity Grade team. Let them try to board the enemy's main ship!"

In this part of the battlefield, the enemy's core was this main ship. Compared to the enemy, Team Seven only had an advantage in the number of Calamity Grades, so it was more cost-effective to carry out a decapitation operation.

Although the tactical goal was to restrain this fleet, the commander only gave them the target, and the specific actions could be changed according to the situation. Destroying the enemy's main ship was more useful than simply restraining them.

If they obtained additional results, the rewards for the tactical mission would be greater.

Including Lagi, the Calamity Grade assault team of Team Seven had a total of four people. Han Xiao was not among them.

After the order was given, Team Seven immediately changed their formation and began to cover the Calamity Grade assault team. They shuttled through the cannon fire and quickly approached the enemy's main ship.

The enemy had also discovered the tactical goal of Han Xiao and the others. They chased after and blocked them, covering the main ship as it left.

Although the distance between the two sides was shrinking, the speed was too slow. The battlefield was moving instead, gradually approaching the more intense main battlefield. Han Xiao saw that it would take forever to chase them.

He shouted, "Calamity Grade team, board my Giant Soldier. I'll bring you there!"

The next moment, Han Xiao ejected from the spaceship, summoned the Ship Destroyer, and sat in the cockpit. Lagi and the others entered the Giant Soldier.

"Sit tight."

Han Xiao controlled the Ship Destroyer, and all of its power flowed into the thrusters as it charged toward the enemy's main ship at high speed.

The Giant Soldier's mobility and agility were higher. Han Xiao's piloting skills were extremely high, and he dove deep into the enemy's formation, attracting a large amount of firepower. However, most of the attacks brushed past him. Not only did they not hit him, but they also almost hit his comrades.

The distance between them was shrinking at a speed visible to the naked eye!

It was taboo for an army to enter deep into enemy territory alone. However, Han Xiao was a Calamity Grade Super, and so were Lagi and the others. They became a sharp blade with extremely strong deterrence, and the enemy had no choice but to divert their attention to deal with them. Team Seven took the opportunity to counterattack, completely restraining this fleet.

The Ship Destroyer finally got close to the main ship. It activated the shield neutralizer and opened the hatch. Lagi and the others successfully blasted open the outer armor of the main ship and broke in. There was only one Calamity Grade Super inside, and he was quickly beaten to death by the four of them.

Han Xiao did not stay idle. He controlled the Giant Soldier to slash open the main ship, and more than twenty frigates around it were also slashed open by him.

Not long after, the main ship could not take the burden and exploded!

Lagi and the others had already retreated. They rode on Han Xiao's Giant Soldier and broke out of the encirclement together, killing their way through the enemy formation.

After successfully destroying the main ship, Han Xiao was not without losses. The Ship Destroyer had almost fallen apart, and its armor value had almost hit rock bottom. If not for the Seventh Squad providing support, the Ship Destroyer would have been destroyed by the enemy's concentrated fire.

However, this small loss turned the tide of the battle. Under the pursuit of the Seventh Squadron, the enemy fleet began to retreat.

Han Xiao was just about to follow up with another attack when he suddenly received a new tactical mission.

[Local Battle: Retreat]

Mission Requirements: Evacuate immediately and preserve as many survivors as possible.

"Why did they suddenly retreat?!"

Han Xiao was shocked. He looked at the tactical screen and his pupils shrank.

He saw that in all the battles, only his own battle line had gained the upper hand!

The situation on the battlefield worsened rapidly. The majority of Section Zero's troops were penetrated by Bloodshed Land, and more than two thousand battleships were destroyed. Of the fifteen Calamity Grade Supers, eight were dead and seven were injured.

The eight Vanguard Officials of the Bloodshed Land had all entered the main battlefield!

"No wonder I didn't meet any of them!"

Han Xiaoxin's heart sank.

Most of his troops had been wiped out. Even if he had the upper hand on the battlefield, it was useless.

Section Zero had lost the first battle with Bloodshed Land!

…

On the main battlefield …

Inside the burning main ship of the Arc Light Organization, corpses were everywhere, and blood flowed like a river.

Puchi!

Hunting Blade pulled out his blade, and Sevitt's body fell down heavily. There was a huge hole in his torso, and almost all of his internal organs had been dug out. His blood had almost dried up, and he couldn't be more dead.

"This should be the last one. This ship is about to explode. Let's quickly retreat."

Jaeger wiped his saber and spoke to Wrothers through the communication device of his armor.

Wrothers was looking at the battlefield through the hole. The terrifying suction force of the vacuum did not cause his body to move at all.

"Black Star is not on the main battlefield … he's lucky."
